_written: 2026-10-14, BEFORE running any Gen49 test. Total project trials before Gen49: ~230 (deflated Sharpe uses 260).

G49a_ns_slope.paper: Bianchi, Fan, Miffre & Zhang (2023, J. Banking & Finance) 'Exploiting the dynamics of commodity futures curves' - S strategy
G49a_ns_slope.rules: daily: if the curve slope rose yesterday (more backwardation) long the slope spread (long nearest, short further contract), else short it; equal weight over commodities; skip a commodity on days its contracts rolled
G49a_ns_slope.deviation: paper: Nelson-Siegel slope on the nearest 4 contracts, spread front vs 4th. Here: slope between the 2 nearest stored contracts (pysystemtrade keeps 2-3).
G49a_ns_slope.data: ~28 commodities 2000-2024, cost 8 bp per leg per trade (paper-level costs)
G49a_ns_slope.pass_rule: net Sharpe >= 0.5 and > 0 in both halves (split 2012-01-01)

G49b_overnight.paper: Liu & Tse (2017, Int. Review of Economics & Finance) 'Overnight returns of stock indexes: evidence from ETFs and futures'
G49b_overnight.rules: (i) long from the 16:00 close to the 09:30 open (New York); (ii) first half hour: trade 09:30-10:00 AGAINST the overnight return sign; (iii) last half hour: trade 15:30-16:00 WITH the overnight return sign
G49b_overnight.data: US500 CFD 15-min 2013-2023 (primary), US100, US30; cost 1 bp/side; overnight CFD financing 1 bp/day on (i) (CFD swap ~ rate + markup; futures embed it)
G49b_overnight.pass_rule: (i) primary net Sharpe >= 0.8 and > 0 in both halves (split 2018-09-01) and positive on US100 and US30; (ii),(iii) same rule

G49c_rest_of_day_momentum.paper: Baltussen, Da, Lammers & Martens (2021, J. Financial Economics) 'Hedging demand and market intraday momentum'
G49c_rest_of_day_momentum.rules: at 15:30 trade in the direction of the return from the previous 16:00 close to 15:30, close at 16:00
G49c_rest_of_day_momentum.pass_rule: net Sharpe >= 0.8 on US500 and positive on US100

G49d_noise_area_multi_index.idea: Zarattini noise-area breakout (gen47, positive but not passed) on US500+US100+US30 together, equal weight
G49d_noise_area_multi_index.pass_rule: net Sharpe >= 0.8 and > 0 in both halves (split 2018-09-01)

G49e_cstar_portfolio_vol.idea: C* (frozen E2+O3) with a portfolio-level Moreira-Muir overlay: scale the whole book by mean past monthly RV / last month's RV of C*'s own returns (cap 2x)
G49e_cstar_portfolio_vol.pass_rule: net Sharpe > C* alone (1.69) by >= 0.1 AND max drawdown not worse

G49f_multi_strategy.idea: risk-parity portfolio of independent sleeves, each run with its pre-registered default settings: C* (crypto daily), noise-area US100 (CFD 15-min, 1 bp), vol-managed S&P 500, curve-momentum optimal-roll, plus any Gen49 sleeve that PASSES its own rule. Weights: inverse of trailing 12-month volatility of each sleeve's daily returns, rebalanced monthly, scaled to 15% annual volatility using trailing volatility.
G49f_multi_strategy.data: common window 2018-09-01 -> 2023-09-11 (where all sleeves have data); daily returns on UTC days, sleeves without weekend data contribute 0 on weekends
G49f_multi_strategy.pass_rule: net Sharpe > C* alone over the SAME window by >= 0.2 AND max drawdown <= C*'s; then report CFT 1-Phase and FTMO prop outcomes
